name: omniflow
description: Standalone multi-channel messaging automation platform for WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger on Cloudflare

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/d1-migration.test.ts tests/health.test.ts tests/crypto.test.ts tests/meta-client.test.ts tests/whatsapp-webhook.test.ts tests/whatsapp-reply.test.ts tests/tenant-isolation.test.ts tests/scheduled.test.ts tests/automation.test.ts tests/admin-routes.test.ts tests/admin-phase3.test.ts tests/messaging-webhooks.test.ts
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply omniflow-db --local --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply omniflow-db --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
